notes: Cash basis (modified cash) school district; all funds governmental. Receipts/disbursements from Exhibit D (p4-5) Total Governmental Funds column, which is after the Reclassifications column that eliminates 212,840.80 of transfers (receipts transfers; disbursements: Regular instruction 45,203.38, Support services SPED school age 42,637.42, Transfers 125,000), so top-level transfers_in/out are null and the identity holds: 6,470,583.28 + 7,813,831.94 - 5,787,895.72 = 8,496,519.50. The 45,000 General-to-Activities transfer is part of Exh D Other Governmental Funds Transfers 212,840.80 (= Nutrition 80,000 + Cooperative 87,840.80 + 45,000), so it is eliminated in the Exh D total column and is not in top-level receipts (Other local receipts 448,108.46 = 437,383.21 + 8,789.76 + 1,935.49 does not include it). In detail, Activities Exh I receipts 288,004.13 include it; the page does not show which account holds it, so a group contra receipt of -45,000 and a +45,000 other financing line were added (Activities revenue detail_total includes other financing: 243,004.13 + 45,000 = 288,004.13). Splits (each from the report's own fund schedules): Taxes Other (5 components, pp8,14,15,16), Non-revenue receipts (p9, p11), Other student support (activities p12 + nutrition p13; inferred, Exh D does not print the split), Debt service (principal vs interest/fees, p14, p16). Exhibit E General Fund Components (p6-7) and Exhibit D fund columns not recorded in detail (duplicates Exh G/H); Depreciation fund is part of the General fund for GASB 54 but is recorded separately from Exh H. General fund revenue detail uses Exhibit G (budget comparison, with budgets). For expenditures, the object-level Exhibit O (cash disbursements for operational expenses, unaudited, p18-24; the v8 re-trim added report pp38-42, so it is now complete through Transfers and Total Cash Disbursements 4,788,050.79 on p24) replaces every nonzero Exh G program line (each program subtotal equals its Exh G line), so nothing is double counted; the Exh G zero-actual program lines (2131, 2153, 2213, 6408), the 8000 Transfers line (Exh O p24 prints the same 125,000 = School Nutrition 80,000 + Activity 45,000) and the contra/other financing pairs stay under Exhibit G, whose expenditure total (p10) counts the Exhibit O lines via includes_schedules. Exhibit O prints Vehicle Operation Capital Assets 200,000.00 (p23), which is the transfer to the Depreciation fund (p6 reclass); recorded as printed plus a -200,000 contra expenditure and a -200,000 other financing line under Exh G. The General fund's payment to the Cooperative fund (87,840.80, reclassified out of Regular instruction 45,203.38 and Support services SPED school age 42,637.42 on p5) sits inside Exh G program lines that cannot be identified, so it is recorded in the General fund as a group contra expenditure (-87,840.80) plus an other financing line (-87,840.80); General detail items: 4,375,209.99 expenditures + 412,840.80 outflow transfers = printed total 4,788,050.79. Cooperative fund items now tie to printed 218,364.01 (receipts 130,523.21 + transfers in 87,840.80; expenditures 218,364.01). Known report quirks: Depreciation fund 4,932.10 other non-revenue receipts shown as Other local receipts on Exh E/F but as non-revenue on Exh D (followed Exh D); County receipts 16,537.33 = 2110 County fines and license fees 16,067.33 + 2210 ESU receipts 470.00 (p8); recorded as fines and forfeitures (dominant, with review); the two codes are categorized separately in detail. Cooperative fund (Exh N) object lines take the dominant function, support services (p4: Regular instruction 90,436.75, SPED school age 127,927.26), with review. Activities fund per-account schedule recorded (Elementary School had no activity, dashes skipped); Exh D shows 23,314.20 Contributions and donations within Activities fund receipts but the per-account schedule cannot separate them. Activity fund budget row (totals only) not recorded. Statement of Net Position (p1) has no liabilities. Read pages 1-24 of 24.
